描述_EN: when they were accidentally unearthed centuries later they became treasured objects of antiquarian scholars and collectors. metalworkers in ancient china made a great variety of food and wine containers in bronze for ritual use. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. these vessels were buried with the dead. this container for grain is called a gui in chinese.
描述_ZN: 当他们在几个世纪后被意外发掘出来时，他们成为了古董学者和收藏家的珍品。 古代中国的金属工匠用青铜制作了大量的食物和酒的容器，供祭祀使用。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 这些器皿与死者埋在一起。 这种装粮食的容器在中国被称为 "圭"。
